items.html: And all these Gevurot, which are the thousand worlds mentioned here, their aspect of Gevura and strength was not revealed in this Mocha, for it is quiet and sits like good wine upon its lees, as above, until they came out in the beard of AA and were revealed there, as written in the first world, see there. And this is what it said, "and from this beard [everything in the Rosh] is known," etc. And these thousand worlds are the root of all the judgments, and from here they spread to all the other places. And in the beard is the beginning of their revelation, for therefore the hairs of the beard are hard and strong. And the fact that they are also a thousand worlds is, that the brain is included of HG, which are the five Hassadim and five Gevurot, each one included of one hundred, and they are one thousand.
